contentList.content: The Stoker
A gnome's hand-built energy emitter, fuelled by a special substance called Euphorite. Hold it the right way round, or risk a serious case of laughing burns!
Tip Cooling
Every attack with the Stoker makes it heat up. After [1] charges of Heat, the emitter jams until it cools down.
Euphorite Beam
Strike the target with a single bolt of energy. Each shot heats the emitter by [1].
Beam Cascade
Strike the target with a fast burst of Euphorite beams, heating the emitter heavily. The cascade heats the emitter by [1] at once.
Overcharge Beam
Pump extra energy into a single shot, dealing an additional [1] on hit. Heats the emitter by [2].
Euphorite Cell
Load a fresh energy cell, clearing all Heat from the emitter at once. Cells refill on a Long Rest.
Reactor Heat
The emitter heats up with every attack, refusing to fire above [1] charges.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> At maximum <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_LASER_HEAT">Heat</LSTag> the emitter overheats and cannot make ranged attacks until it cools.
Euphorite Cells
Emotion Regulator

Dealing damage with the Stoker forces the target to make a Charisma Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC, or fall into uncontrollable laughter for [1] turns.

Triggers no more than once per turn.
Jaguar's Bite

The jaguar-priests of a drowned Maztican city wore these to open the throats of captives. Obsidian, not steel — the Feathered Serpent has no use for iron. Centuries later a trader bought the pair for two healing draughts, and never once wondered whose teeth he was holding.
Obsidian Rake
Rake your foe with obsidian-edged knuckles, dealing [1].
Run-Down

An unarmed strike against a creature already below half its Hit Points deals an extra [1].
Works even in Wild Shape.
Gutting Throw
Targets of your throwing attacks additionally take [1] and start Bleeding.
Seal of Savras

Savras sees every road a thing might take, and a seer of his temple poured one such road into steel. The blue eye at the knuckle is a splinter of a divining lens — it knows where the blow lands before the arm decides. The seer foresaw plague, betrayal, the burning of his order. He did not foresee that he would sell the relic himself, cheaply, to cover a gambling debt.
Seer's Strike
Your unarmed strikes land as foreseen blows, dealing [1].
Second Sight

When an unarmed attack roll comes up below [1], it is foreseen and rerolled once, taking the higher result.
Works even in Wild Shape.
Foreseen Fall
Targets of your throwing attacks additionally take [1] and fall Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC.
The Sarrukh Sigil, Knuckle of the First Makers

Older than the elves, older perhaps than the gods men name. The sign cut into the charoite matches no alphabet any sage has catalogued, and the stone wakes to a dull violet whenever blood is spilled near it. The Sarrukh who shaped it are dust and legend now. The knuckle remembers them anyway — it grows heavier, surer, hungrier the longer a fight drags on, as if some old patience inside it is finally being repaid.
First Makers' Blow
Your unarmed strikes fall like the First Makers' own, dealing [1] and [2].
Whetting

Each unarmed strike you land grants a charge of Whetting, stacking up to [1] times. A miss spends them all.
Works even in Wild Shape.
Whetting
Your unarmed strikes deal an extra [1] for each charge, up to [2].
Sundering Cast
Targets of your throwing attacks additionally take [1] and are flung back [2] unless they succeed a Strength Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC.
Horus-Re's Verdict, The Amber Talon That Weighs Every Soul in Eternal Light

In Mulhorand the god-kings did not argue with the guilty; they weighed them. This relic belonged to an incarnation of Horus-Re, and the amber at its heart is said to hold a single drop of the first sunrise. Strike an honest foe and it is only gold on your fist. Strike a tyrant, and the wings unfold, the light leans in, and the verdict is read whether the accused consents or not.
Verdict
Your unarmed strikes fall as a god-king's verdict, dealing [1].
Weighing of the Heart

Every unarmed strike smites with [1]. The Undead are weighed harder, taking an extra [2]. Your unarmed Critical Hits roll additional dice.
Works even in Wild Shape.
Verdict
Toggleable feature. While active, each of your unarmed strikes also deals [1], but attacks against you are made with Advantage.
Cast Down
Targets of your throwing attacks additionally take [1] and are Blinded unless they succeed a Constitution Saving Throw against your Maneuver DC. The Undead take a further [2].
Knuckle Strike
Your unarmed strikes are delivered through the knuckles, dealing a base [1]. Monks keep their Martial Arts die instead.
